caption:
Small good deeds: never belittle even a cheerful face.

No act of goodness is too small to count. Start today by greeting the first person you meet with a warm face.

Sahih Muslim 6690 · Grade: Sahih

Who will be the first person you greet warmly today?

#smalldeeds #cheerfulface #muslimmanners #hadith
alt_text: Abu Dharr reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to me: Don't consider anything insignificant out of good things even if it is that you meet your brother with a cheerful countenance (Sahih Muslim 6690)
